title: sdd.json zones can disagree with the zones its files actually touch
desc:
references/sdd.md says zones come from wb repo zones and must not be hand-written, but nothing compares doc.zones with profile.critical_zones(files). The tier is computed correctly; the rendered plan (sdd render, pr context) can still show zones that are wrong or missing.

ACCEPTANCE:
- sdd audit adds a structure problem when doc.zones differs from critical_zones of the listed paths, naming the difference
- regression test
